newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine 2-months approved investments up 85 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippine 2-months approved investments up 85 pct.

text.p: The Board of Investments said on Thursday it approved projects worth 48.35 billion pesos in the first two months of the year, 85 percent higher than 26.18 billion pesos in the year-earlier period.

These projects, which will be entitled to fiscal incentives, represent the potential investments that will coming in. These will be able to enjoy income tax holidays and the minimum three percent duty on imported capital equipment.
For February alone, the approved projects were worth 26.27 billion pesos versus 6.42 billion pesos in the year-ago month, the government said.
